notes: DC Fire and EMS Department (FEMS) Monthly Operating Reports, average response time for Higher Priority EMS Calls (G1-C2-C3), First Responder, aggregated from 12 published monthly averages for DC fiscal year 2018 (Oct 2017-Sep 2018), mapped directly to Mandate's calendar-year label. Same convention as this project's existing NYC emergency_response_minutes import (average EMS response for life-threatening medical calls, not fire, not a true median despite the metric's stated definition -- neither city actually publishes a median).

Same source/methodology as 2018 (FY2023). Cross-checked against a call-volume-weighted average for this year, which landed within 0.01 min of the simple mean, confirming the aggregation is safe. FEMS stopped publishing these Monthly Operating Reports after FY23 -- FY2024/2025 only have percent-within-NFPA-threshold KPIs (e.g. '54.9% of higher-priority EMS calls met the arrival benchmark'), a different statistical shape that cannot be cleanly converted to an average-minutes figure. 2015-2017 predate FEMS's own operating-report series, which itself states it began in FY18 -- a confirmed structural gap, not unresearched.
